chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
I am God’s servant and the brother of His Messenger. Whoever claims anything else after me is a liar.
ai.seo_question: What does Ali (a.s.) mean when he says 'I am the brother of God's Messenger'?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Ali (a.s.) asserts his exclusive right to the titles 'Abd Allah' and 'Akhu Rasul Allah' (Brother of the Messenger), a claim rooted in the Hadith al-Dhikr where he was designated as Muhammad's brother in faith and lineage. This declaration serves as a foundational proof for the Imams' unique spiritual authority, implying that any successor claiming this specific dual status after Ali is engaging in falsehood, thereby reinforcing the concept of *Nass* (designation) in Shia theology.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-262 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
“I am God’s servant and the brother of His Messenger (a.s.). Whoever claims anything else is a liar.”
